body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

Example in the Run-time loading and saving demo:

### Thumbnails

![Thumbnails](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2553b8af-7257-4052-90e2-698d3b0ae2bf)

### List

![List](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6c05421-4016-4de9-9801-5ae14ba51132)

I agree it's fine to change to thumbnails mode by default, as it better matches most OS file explorers' default appearance. I still think we should implement per-project persistence in the long run (using metadata saved to `user://`). The display mode property would then only act as an initial value, and the user preference would take priority.

One downside of the thumbnails mode though is that it exposes the [issues with label wrapping](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12011) in projects, while it was previously editor-only.

There could also be a slider to change the thumbnail size (for both thumbnail and list mode), but that's better left for a future proposal/PR.

PS: I see there's a separator on the right of the Favorites icon in the top-right corner, but there's no icon past the separator. I would remove it (if there's an icon that appears conditionally, the separator should also appear conditionally).
